about.title: About me
about.alt: Portrait of Silvina Paola with long braids, smiling at the camera
paragraphs: Silvina Paola Torcigliani (born October 1, 1985) is a vocal artist and performer based in Córdoba, Argentina.
Her bond with music began at the age of seven, singing alongside her godmother and her guitar. In 2010 she began her vocal training and set out to explore different musical languages.
Since 2019, her path as a singer and performer has taken deeper root through shared projects and stage experiences.
Her artistic universe is defined by stylistic versatility and a curiosity for other languages and cultures.

music.epText: Silvina Paola’s first solo record brings together five original songs, with her own lyrics, music and performance. Conceived as an emotional journey, each song opens a new stage between pain, transformation and finding oneself. An invitation to listen, to feel and to discover one’s own meanings through music.

projection.title: Artistic vision
projection.phrase: Music as a place of encounter, creation and discovery.
projection.alt: Silvina Paola on stage with one arm raised, in black and white
paragraphs: Silvina Paola looks toward new stages and experiences that will broaden her artistic horizons and reveal other ways of creating and performing.
Her path through different styles, languages and ensembles feeds her desire to take part in stage projects, collaborations and cultural exchanges that nurture exploration and shared learning.
With an open gaze toward artistic diversity, she seeks to keep building a career in which performance is also a way of meeting other people, cultures and ways of feeling music.
